combinatorics: A seven-vertex path template has C(7,2)-6=15 nonconsecutive pairs.
For B-C-B-C-X0-C-B these split by endpoint types as: 3 B-B, 5 B-C, 3 B-X0, 1 C-X0, 3 C-C.
frozen_semantics: All three B roles have exact dynamic list {1,4}; X0 has fixed color 4. Hence each nonconsecutive B-X0 insertion removes color 4 and changes A(B).
C1=z2 has base list {1,3,4}; the unique nonconsecutive C-X0 insertion to x0c4 removes color 4 and changes B_C1.
Every B-C candidate changes anticomplete-to-complete status for a singleton residual component and therefore changes D_C.
Every B-B candidate changes the copied dynamic graph G[U].
source_iv: C1-C2: B1 is adjacent to C1 and nonadjacent to C2, so adding C1-C2 creates a Y0 edge mixed on by B1.
C1-C3: B1 is adjacent to C1 and nonadjacent to C3, giving the same violation.
C2-C3: B2 is adjacent to C2 and nonadjacent to C3, giving the same violation.
Thus all three C-C chords are source-forbidden by axiom (iv).
conclusion: 12 chords are source-optional but change a tracked object.
3 chords are source-forbidden and would merge residual components.
0 chords are semantics-neutral in the frozen T0 annotation.
generalization_firewall: In arbitrary source states, a B-X0 or C-X0 identity edge may leave the color mask unchanged if the same fixed color is already seen through another X0 vertex.
Therefore the frozen T0 conclusion is not promoted to all source-valid templates without a color-annotated complete generator.
